description: React component for a commercial support modal in Mattermost, allowing users to download support packets and submit support tickets.

classes.name: CommercialSupportModal
classes.description: React component class for displaying a modal that provides support packet download options and support ticket submission.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: React lifecycle method to update banner warning state when props change.

methods.name: doHide
methods.description: Hides the modal by setting show state to false.

methods.name: hideBannerWarning
methods.description: Hides the banner warning by setting showBannerWarning to false.

methods.name: updateCheckStatus
methods.description: Toggles the selected state of a support packet content item.

methods.name: genereateDownloadURLWithParams
methods.description: Constructs a download URL with query parameters based on selected support packet contents.

methods.name: extractFilename
methods.description: Extracts filename from content-disposition header or generates a default filename.

methods.name: downloadSupportPacket
methods.description: Fetches the support packet zip file and triggers download, handling errors.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal UI including support link, warning banner, support packet options, and download button.
